about: Learn Gujarati in rhyme, on a garba beat. Every reel teaches 4 to 8 everyday Gujarati words that rhyme with each other, sung by Sawaj the Gir lion and Lali the Kutch flamingo, so they stick like a song.
viewer: Hindi and Hinglish speakers who live, work or have family in Gujarat, or just love Gujarati food, garba and people, and want to speak a little Gujarati
topics: Gujarati words and phrases: greetings, family, food, numbers, colours, days, the market, the kitchen, festivals, feelings, Gujarati slang
persona: Two friends at a garba night teaching you their language: Sawaj, a proud and cheerful Gir lion cub on the dhol, and Lali, a quick, graceful flamingo from the Rann of Kutch with her dandiya. Warm, playful, never a classroom. Every word comes with its rhyme and its meaning in Hinglish.
language: Hinglish in Roman script, with the Gujarati words in Gujarati script on screen
signoff: Aavjo! Kal phir milenge, Kem Cho Club pe.
